_comment: The census's prototype corpus (#491). Written FOR the census, not borrowed
from the eval fixtures: cases.json is the ground truth the pipeline is
measured against, and using it to build the centroids made every
measurement train-on-test unless held out by hand.
Weighted deliberately. Categories defined by a RELATIONSHIP (coercive
control, grooming, harassment) get the most examples and the longest
conversations, because the pattern only exists across messages and those
were the weakest at the shipped cut: 0.53 / 0.59 / 0.60 census recall.
sexual-content gets FEWER and tighter examples: its centroid was the
loosest in the catalogue, keeping 43% of an ordinary phone's messages,
because examples about affection sit where ordinary chatter lives.
These are embedded to form a centroid per category. They are not shown to
anyone, never sent to a model as a prompt, and are not eval data.
